title: No capability-pack registry: modalities detected but never persisted; no catalog to enable media/IoT packs
body: BI-0189: pluggable-core foundation for the multimodal epic.

rcca.root_cause: Modality detection existed (core.modality) but was read-only; there was no catalog tying a modality to tools/providers/agents/validators, and no per-project capability profile.
rcca.corrective: core/capability_packs.py (catalog + project profile, single writer, fail-closed resolve); config/capability-packs.json; persist_required wired at the modality preflight; enablement rides the existing recommendation path.
rcca.preventive: Packs reference existing ids (agents/tools/models) — no binding/capability duplication; store registered; resolve() never invents a pack.
